brief.zh: 村里的理发师说：「我给且只给不给自己刮胡子的人刮胡子。」已知「有这么一个人 x：对所有 y，x 给 y 刮胡子 ↔ y 不给自己刮」，证明出矛盾 ⊥。
brief.en: The village barber says: “I shave exactly those who do not shave themselves.” Given “there is an x such that for every y, x shaves y ↔ y does not shave himself”, prove the contradiction ⊥.

t.zh: 目标推得出时，饱和器迟早推出 ⊥；推不出时，它未必停得下来。有没有一台机器，对每个目标都答得出推得出还是推不出？这个专题从<level-ref to="kk-one"></level-ref>的<part-ref to="lemma:liar"></part-ref>说起。
t.en: When a goal follows, the saturator reaches ⊥ sooner or later; when it does not, the saturator may never stop. Is there a machine that can say, for every goal, whether it follows? This topic starts from <part-ref to="lemma:liar"></part-ref> in <level-ref to="kk-one"></level-ref>.

after.en: This kind of argument is the <wiki-ref to="diagonal"></wiki-ref>.
